so this is a note for DMs and Mods but I dont want to ping everyone:

All mods will be given a rank called GM.  this rank lets them assist in managing avrae's built in init tracker.  By using said tracker, it keeps init in a pinned message within discord, and avrae will ping people when its their init. itll take a little getting used to (for instance I have not figured out how to force something to go on a specific init yet, like make a creature whose init is always on 1 or set legendary actions for init 20).

In addition, there are 5 invitational ranks that when a dm sets players or mods to, will make them appear above mods in the person list, but will not change their color (so mods will still be red, players purple).  The idea is once you have a group for invitational/event, a DM can create a room, or lock a room to only allow dm's, bots, and people with the right invitational rank to be able to post in said room, or talk in an appropriate voice channel, and you can let everyone else live in read only mode (though id likely let them react casue its fun).

Once that group is done, the DM will need to remove the rank from those players and mods, and unlock any room that is approprate for players to now be able to interact with

I figure, over 5 weeks, 35 days, that ammounts to 35k gold. That seems like a reasonable goal to shoot for. I figure people will be getting special quest items too. Could throw in a very rare once in a while, and I'd stay away from legendary, unless you want things to get out of hand.

This breakdown is pretty accurate. I realized I'm responding to these in reverse. I would rather have players trading among each other than just buying them from the store, so I'd like to limit where they can buy them. It doesn't need to be impossible, but maybe make them work for it a bit first. They need to be on good terms with a faction, or maybe only one type of shard is available from any given vendor. The price should also be high. I'd say 50% more at least. Since this is a stand-in for gold and other valuable items, I figured they could sell them at face value. They are a hot commodity.

I guess my last thought on needing any special equipment would be that yes, I'd love to have that be a thing, but I want to keep the complexity down for the ease of everyone. Feel free to require that for specific items, as needed. I'm giving a lot of adjudication freedom to you all, so go ahead and run with it. There may be other requirements for crafting as you see fit. This is the basics. Some items may need two or more different kinds of "shards" or "resources" or whatever we will call it. I wanted to get every item tagged with a quality, but it was too daunting of a task. So let's improve our way to success! 

Thanks everyone for going along with this. Let me know if any questions or edge cases come up as you play.
